metadata.displayName: Omega 24 Well Gripper Lid (Estimated Fit Prototype)
tags: Estimated-fit PETG lift-release prototype; not robot-ready or OEM-approved
3 mm splash collars only; not sealed; breathable film thickness excluded
CAD envelope 116.4 x 88 x 23.15 mm; seated top 2.4 mm above plate rim
Fixed jaw planes 88 mm apart; grip 20.25 mm above lowest clip feet
15 N is the SDK default, PROVISIONAL and uncalibrated; verify before physical robot use
Only park on another empty Omega plate; unstable on bare deck and not self-stackable
SDK 10.1: when parking on a deck-mounted Omega plate, use +0.75 mm Z drop_offset to cancel the deck drop bias; not for the Heater-Shaker adapter
Stop shaking before lid movement; keep Heater-Shaker latch closed
Fit, retention, extraction, collisions, film adhesion and 37 C / 900 rpm / 48 h performance unverified
